name: Prone Neck Extension
steps: Lie facedown on a flat bench with your upper chest near the edge and your head hanging freely off the end.
Grip the edges of the bench lightly to keep your upper torso stable and relax your neck downward.
Lift your head smoothly upward by extending your neck until your gaze faces slightly forward in a comfortable range.
Lower your head slowly back down toward the floor under full control.
tips: Avoid wrenching your head far backward into painful end-range cervical compression.
Keep your upper back steady on the bench and move at a calm, controlled tempo.
